name: Toulouse Business School
description: TBS Education, previously Toulouse Business School and Groupe ESC Toulouse (École supérieure de Commerce de Toulouse), is a triple crown business school established by the Toulouse Chamber of Commerce and Industry in 1903. This pretty selective grande école (an institution of higher learning that accepts applicants after two years of post-baccalaureate preparation) offers a variety of programs, including the most prestigious program, known as the "Grande Ecole" Program (PGE), as well as a joint DBA (bac + 8) with the University of Toulouse, Toulouse School of Management. It is a member of the Federal University of Toulouse Midi-Pyrénées and the Conférence des grandes écoles, and it has earned triple accreditation from EQUIS, AACSB, and AMBA (CGE). It maintains business schools in Toulouse, Paris, Barcelona, and Casablanca and educates more than 7,000 students annually in its first and continuing training programs, many of whom are international, offering business courses in English, French, and Spanish.
